Sử Thi Loot has updated to version {0}. Configs you have not changed were refreshed automatically, but these have local changes and were left alone:

{1}

They will not receive new content or balance changes while they differ from the defaults.

Replace them with the new defaults? Your current files will be backed up to <color=#ffd700>BepInEx/config/Sử ThiLoot/baseconfig-backup</color> first.

Choosing No keeps your versions, and you will only be asked again if these configs change in a future update.
We hope you enjoy Sử Thi loot! Sử Thi loot is maintained by a community of modders and dedicated players, thank you to everyone that has contributed!
There are some big changes since the last time you played Sử Thi Loot: <color=#4fd6ff>Đá Mảnh</color> and <color=#ff8c3a>Tôi Luyện</color>.

<color=#4fd6ff>Đá Mảnh</color> drop across every biome and from bosses. They can be slotted into items with shard slots.
<color=#ff8c3a>Tôi Luyện</color> is a service Hildir provides, and lets you reroll the value of an enchantment you already have.

To improve your experience, it's recommended to pick an overhaul configuration now (default balanced). Each provides a different level of power and a different mix of what drops. Next to each is the expected damage and hp bonus you may find:
 - Tối Thiểu    hp +(1 - 10), dmg +(1-6)% 
 - Cân Bằng    hp +(1-18), dmg +(1-12)% 
 - Huyền Thoại    hp +(1-28), dmg +(1-20)%
All of it can be changed later in the config.

Inscribed with runes, the sword of Fritiof is dim in times of peace, but brightly glows in times of war.
The spirits of the deathsquitos remain in this weapon, thirsting to drink deep of blood and grow strong.
Sword of King Ryhdderch Hael the Generous. When drawn by a worthy soul, the entire blade blazes with fire.
Forged from star fire and imbued with the legacy of your heroic deeds, this bow will never fail you. The Hunter of the Forsaken will never falter.
The blade pulled from the tree, broken by Odin and reforged by dwarves, the slayer of Fafnir- it is the legendary blade itself!
Fashioned from the wood of the world tree Yggdrasil and engraved with the contracts from which Odin's power derives.
Gunnar Hámundarson's legendary Atgeir, said to sing when taken down for battle. It cuts as sharp as any song.
You, warrior, enter the sanctuary of Himinbjorg. Be at rest in Heimdall's tranquil home and drink joyful of the good mead.

"Nine Jotunn maids gave birth, to the gracious god, Heimdall, at the world's edge. Strong was he made with the might of the Earth, with the ice-cold Sea, and with Boar's blood." -Voluspa hin skamma, Poetic Edda
Heimdall, in his eternal vigilance, was blessed by the Aesir to appear precisely where and when he was needed the most.
None shall cross the burning rainbow bridge of Bifrost whilst Heimdall bars the way.
The sword of Heimdall, the watchman of the gods and the keeper of the Bifrost bridge to Asgard. This blade is truly worthy of the eternal watchman.
Let all those who think they are safe and forever protected know- Odin's war is coming.
Created to destroy the falcon Víðópnir, it crackles with godlike energies.
Lancing Luff's Lancer Lance of Lancing
"Mjolnir hurled forth towards the savage crew, and slew all the mountain-giants, who with Hyimir had him pursued." -Hymiskvida, Poetic Edda
The god Njǫrd, ruler of wind, sea, and riches, caught a piece of hurricane gale and fashioned it into this knife. A blade as swift and cutting as the northern wind.
The blade that sliced the dire-serpent's head from its body, thus winning Ragnar the affections of Thora Borgarhjort.
Provides you with wisdom, cunning, and mastery of battle tactics. Especially when invading Northumbria.
Wear this cuirass when you seek vengeance or justice.
Go forth, and inflict great slaughter upon the enemy, gained from the strength of your Ironsides.
Forged from shards harvested from the shattered edges of reality iself, from when Valheim was sundered from the realms.
The favored weapon of the goddess of the hunt, it's weilder is imbued with the swiftness of her legendary skis.
The blade of legendary king Hrólfr Kraki, supernaturally sharp and imbued with the souls of his 12 faithful berserker bodyguards.
A gnarled and mummified horse's foreleg. The hoof is incredibly hard and sharp. Those who weild it feel the urge to gallop.
In the aftermath of a epic, primordial battle, an illusive Celestial Being forged this weapon to spite the Black Sun.
Ullr's mighty bow of the winter hunt, often given as a reward to those who have done favors for Odin. It seems that you are the latest to have gained his gratitude.
Those nearest to death are closest to glory.
